## Description

Decomposes multi-horizon stock return series into discrete wavelet frequency sub-bands, passing each frequency component through dedicated LSTM cells to generate multi-scale cross-sectional alpha rankings.

## Where it may fit

Systematic multi-factor equity ranking, mixed-frequency trading signal generation.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Systematic Factor Investing Desks.

## Required data

Daily and intraday OHLCV price series, fundamental factor panels across stock universes.

## Caveats

Careful alignment of wavelet boundary padding is required to prevent look-ahead bias across rebalance dates.
